notesStmt.note: This manuscript was likely composed in the early 1880s, sometime before August 1885.

A manuscript containing what appear to be trial titles, most likely for the poem that was eventually titled "Last of Ebb, and Daylight Waning." Another manuscript contains a draft of a poem titled "Ebb-tide whisperings" (one of the title proposed here), and is clearly an early draft of "Last of Ebb." The poem was first published in Nineteenth Century magazine in August 1885, as part of a cluster of poems titled "Fancies at Navesink." The cluster, including this poem, then appeared in November Boughs (1888). The relationship of the titles on the recto to the lines on the verso are unclear, although they seem to be related to the same general project.
